name: Johnny McGorey's Pub
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: Apple Maps, Chamber of Commerce directory, and the band Worst Case Scenario's show list (wcsrocks.com), which places its McGorey's shows in Massapequa Park.
reviewNotes: Irish pub with live bands. Another Johnny McGorey's is in Lynbrook (46 Atlantic Ave); Ira's List's "Johnny McGorey's Pub" gigs are this one. Research the dance floor.
